payload.description:
As a CLI user, I want kanbus dep --help and usage errors to show the real argument shapes with examples, so that I do not guess the syntax.

Actual syntax today: kanbus dep <id> blocked-by|relates-to <target> | kanbus dep <id> remove <type> <target> | kanbus dep tree <id>.
CLI_REFERENCE.md currently documents a nonexistent `kanbus dep add` — correct it.

Feature: Dependency CLI help
  Scenario: dep help shows examples
    Given a Kanbus project with default configuration
    When I run "kanbus dep --help"
    Then the command should succeed
    And stdout should contain "blocked-by"
    And stdout should contain "relates-to"
    And stdout should contain "remove"
    And stdout should contain "tree"

  Scenario: dep with too few arguments shows usage examples
    Given a Kanbus project with default configuration
    When I run "kanbus dep"
    Then the command should fail
    And stderr should contain "blocked-by"
payload.title: Discoverable dep help and usage errors
